answer: Each identity plants a ferrous anchor on the shared knoll: 30 POA locked 60 days, released only after six epochs of verified work. A second identity from one funding source needs a 45 POA anchor locked 70 days, a third 67 POA for 80 days, each step 50% dearer and 10 days longer. Five auditors check each epoch's work; one failure forfeits the anchor and bars that source for three epochs. Idle anchors rust, losing 5 POA per idle epoch, so a zephyr of fresh work must blow through every epoch or the stake decays.
